assessment_scope.source_boundary: Only re-zero:theresia-van-astrea@light-novel#character-model, the canonical generation V1.0 Theresia van Astrea V01-V20 source-bounded character model at basis_commit, read in full as reviewed repository analysis of the admitted Japanese main light novels; the model declares that its targeted recovery revisits already consumed V07, V08, V09, V16 and V20, that V18 and V19 were identity-pinned rather than reread, that most of Theresia's life comes from the Theresia-focalized V20 p-008 retrospective with the V07 youth account and others' attributed accounts beside it, and that the V01-V20 label is a horizon, not an appearance in every volume. The project's current-state entrypoint was read for method, authority order, gate state and scope only. The frozen volume readings, the specialist and master ledgers, the source lock, the reconstruction protocol, the separate Theresia fidelity review and the Japanese EPUBs are not curated evidence on this subject and nothing is borrowed from them; V21 and later, EX, IF, web-novel, supplement and adaptation material is excluded.
assessment_scope.temporal_boundary: The model's required default T11, V20 RZ-E-021 after Theresia's body becomes ashes, at which no current living reply is available; plus its explicit selectors T0-T10: childhood fear of the Death God blessing, the forced Sword Saint inheritance test at twelve, the first deployment, the private flower field at nineteen, the chosen rescue and public fighting, the ceremonial contest and proposal, married life, the near-fifty expedition departure, the fog and blackout, the controlled body in E021 (T9, no ordinary personal agency established) and the brief final recognition of Wilhelm before dissolution (T10). The more than twenty years of marriage are narrated in summary; ages are given but no in-world dates are fixed; nothing after the ashes reaches her.
assessment_scope.assessment_method: characters/RECONSTRUCTION_CAPABILITY_SPEC.md and governance/policies/CHARACTER_RECONSTRUCTION_MAINTENANCE.md at basis_commit; evidence-located calibration with countercases, explicit gaps and no model-readiness inheritance.

dimensions.note: Section 1 states a governing argument (Theresia finds people and purposes for which she can use a power she first experiences as a threat) and section 1.1 separates stable candidates from state-dependent revisions; section 4 distinguishes her wants, attention and knowledge per phase, section 10 tests eight rival reconstructions against discriminating evidence, and twenty-eight conditional rules carry trigger, priority, exception and confidence (22 HIGH, 6 MEDIUM). Theresia's self-blame and early judgments of her brothers are kept as her self-model rather than the analyst's verdict. It is one same-analyst artifact, six rules are MEDIUM, and most of the inner account rests on a single retrospective sequence, so A is not supported; the rival readings, explicit motive conflicts (rescue with private possessiveness, protection that restricts Wilhelm) and direct interior exceed specialist interpretation alone, so C is not supported.

Section 2.1 maps twelve phases T0-T11 with knowledge, recipient, bodily and transfer-gate coordinates, and the source narrates real development rather than persistence: fear of accidental wounding (R01), unwilling gifted victory (R02), first-battle inaction (R05), chosen rescue (R14), and after marriage an explicitly attested intentional control of the Death God blessing (R20) that the child lacked; NC02 and P01 test that phase transfer. The more than twenty married years are summarized, the life is reconstructed mainly from one V20 retrospective plus the V07 youth account, and T9 agency is unresolved, so A is not supported; development is located phase by phase with explicit firewalls, so C is not supported.

Section 7 gives eleven short located Japanese anchors with pragmatic use: courtesy あら、ごめんなさい (V20 p-008#B0115), the coaxing おいでおいで (V07 p-014#B0104), the recurring flower and sword questions (B0173/B0175), the boundary もう、ここにはこないわ (B0297), the request for spoken love (B0381/B0385), the firm decision もう決めたことよ (B0428), the rebuke of blaming Heinkel (B0433), and the depleted 馬鹿な人 (B0539); it separates the multi-owner command 剣を持ちなさい、テレシア and the unasked first-sight question. Almost every sample is addressed to Wilhelm, there is no lexical or sentence-ending inventory, and the model itself marks public, ceremonial and military registers JAPANESE_REGISTER_SAMPLE_TOO_NARROW, so B is not supported; the anchors are located and conditioned on recipient and aim, so D is not supported.

Section 6 locates ordinary conduct: gardening when the inheritance arrives, the neglected household bed beside the unwatered secret field (R07), earlier visits and delayed names (R10), small irritations at the flower-woman label and short visits, a suppressed blush (R13), and positively narrated married calm; it refuses favorite meals, spending, sleep, wardrobe, division of household labor and occupation. The ordinary scenes are few and most sit in the courtship field, and married routine is summary, so B is not supported; they are located, rule-structured and bounded with counterevidence (NC03), so D is not supported.

Section 5 differentiates the eldest brother テムズ (trusted comfort and confession, R04), the second elder カルラン, the younger カジレス, the unnamed coercive uncle and his late apology (R06), parents and the loyal female attendant, Wilhelm before marriage and as husband, Heinkel, Luanna, Reinhard, the kingdom and the unknown visitor; section 5.1 gives matched-recipient contrasts (the same command from the uncle, from herself, and a loved person's request; marital teasing denied to an unfamiliar outsider). Unlike a purely adversarial record, a long reciprocal relation is attested from her side. Most relations other than Wilhelm rest on one or two passages, the comparisons are documentary rather than controlled and the artifact is single, so A is not supported; the multi-phase recipient-specific conduct with stated exceptions exceeds C.

The V20 p-008 retrospective is Theresia-focalized across T0-T8 and T10: fear of wounding, hope that the eldest ends the test, contempt for practice and its correction, possessive thought during the rescue, inward denial of mockery, the wish to drop the sword at the ceremony, knowing love from conduct while wanting words, self-blame before the expedition, the succession recognition, and the final sensing of family and the unasked first-sight question (E01-E20, E23). The model keeps that interior apart from what listeners receive (NC19, NC25). The interior is concentrated in one retrospective chapter and T9 has none, so A is not supported; direct, extended focalized interior across phases exceeds inference from conduct, so C is not supported.

Located conflict episodes are distinct in type: first-battle inaction (R05), the chosen rescue and killing (R14), withdrawal after Wilhelm's accusation (R15), the real ceremonial contest she does not throw (R17), sharp correction inside affection (R21), the rebuke of blaming Heinkel (R22), the deliberate wound that restricts Wilhelm's pursuit (R23), and the attack on the unknown visitor (R25); section 10 rejects both the serene-pacifist and the omniscient-expert readings. Each type rests on a single episode, R15, R21 and R25 are MEDIUM, combat technique is mostly summary and the T9 duel is not her ordinary agency, so B is not supported; the conflicts are located and ruled with exceptions, so D is not supported.

The evidence locates value choices in her own focalization: choosing to wield the sword for Wilhelm despite horror (R14), widening protection to family and kingdom (R16), resisting a one-sided assignment of blame while taking responsibility herself (R22), and deciding that protecting the family justifies restricting Wilhelm by a wound she promises to close (R23); the model keeps her self-blame as her allocation of responsibility (R06, NC18), not a verdict. Explicit weighing of competing claims is brief, and the model says protective intent is not full negotiation, so B is not supported; the choices are located and ruled across phases, so D is not supported.

Teasing and play are located and tied to rules: deflating Wilhelm's intimidating face (怖い顔して, R08), coaxing おいでおいで, pouting at his deferred answer and teasing a deferral (R19), the sharp familiar correction of his age remark (余計なことは言わないの, R21), and the affectionate 馬鹿な人 in the depleted farewell; Wilhelm's comic V08 recollection is kept attributed. Humor is not analyzed as a register, nearly all of it is directed at Wilhelm and instances are few, so B is not supported; it is located and rule-bound, so D is not supported.

Section 0 declares the admitted Japanese V01-V20 horizon and excludes V21 and later, EX, IF, web-novel and adaptation material; section 3 pins the five revisited originals by hash and routes thirty bundles E01-E30 to exact block ranges; section 14 records 1,489 selected positions and the separately added V08 counterevidence, and states that counts and hashes do not prove attention or absence elsewhere. The readings, ledgers, source lock and EPUBs are outside this evidence set, V18 and V19 were only identity-pinned and the series continues past V20, so B is not supported; the boundary is exact and located, so D is not supported.

Affirmative located limits and contradictions: first-battle inaction and the eldest's death (E04-E05), her misreading of her brothers' practice corrected by the eldest (NC04), the neglected household bed and unwatered field (NC03), the hurtful accusation answered by withdrawal rather than disclosure, a ceremonial contest genuinely lost (NC12), the blessing retained through marriage (NC13), the corpse's apparent emotion corrected as Wilhelm's illusion at V20 p-006#B0045 (NC23), the first-sight question explicitly left unasked (NC25), the Death God wound effects ceasing while deep injury persists, and the family rupture after the ashes (NC26); twenty-eight adverse controls also reject false denials (NC14, NC24). All of it lives in one same-analyst artifact whose locators were not rechecked here, so A is not supported; these are located counterinstances rather than gaps, so C is not supported.

Section 2 fixes a terminal default and twelve phases with knowledge firewalls: the child lacks later deaths, romance and control; the departing wife does not know the visitor or later accusations; Julius's report to Subaru, Subaru's inference and the post-ash family events never reach her (E25, E26, E29); the V07 youth account is historical, not a new live occurrence; T9 conduct and T10 response have separate support (R26, R27). Ages anchor several phases, but no in-world dates are fixed, the married decades are compressed and the artifact is single, so A is not supported; the firewalls are explicit and located, so C is not supported.

conditions: A living phase T0-T8, or the brief T10 interval, is selected with all seven coordinates; the T11 default yields analytical description or abstention, never a current, posthumous or afterlife reply, and T9 yields no generated personal speech.
Output reproduces the recipient- and aim-conditioned strategies of section 7 in paraphrase; exact Japanese is cited only from a located passage and any new wording is labeled NONCANONICAL_PROBE.
Private interior stays private: the first-sight question is never uttered, and the multi-owner sword command is not merged into a public statement by a deity.
Intimate teasing, requests for spoken love and touch are reserved for Wilhelm in a phase where that history exists; public, ceremonial and military registers end in abstention.
scenario_readiness.note: R28 blocks any present living reply and R26 blocks personal speech from the controlled body, while section 7 supplies located wording across courtesy, teasing, boundary-setting, intimate request, firm decision and depleted farewell. READY would treat a Wilhelm-centered sample of short anchors as a voice inventory; NOT_READY would deny located, phase-selected speech strategies the model explicitly supports. This bounds the evidence set, not Theresia's speech.

conditions: A living phase is selected explicitly; nothing is attributed to the T11 default, T9 receives no ordinary assent, and no survival, restoration or post-ash knowledge is assumed.
The interlocutor is an attested relation in the register and knowledge the phase allows; an unfamiliar recipient receives no inherited intimacy, touch or shared ritual.

Output is labeled NONCANONICAL_PROBE, follows each rule's stated confidence and keeps the six MEDIUM rules conditional; development is not transferred backward (no adult blessing control for the child, no marriage certainty at the field).
Blessing range, succession mechanics, the visitor's identity, Luanna's condition and unnamed relatives' names end in abstention.

cross_scenario_scope.assumed_chronology: One named living phase among T0-T8, from childhood fear of the Death God blessing through the expedition fog before blackout, or the brief T10 recognition interval in V20 RZ-E-021; by default the latest state is ashes and supports no new action.
cross_scenario_scope.interlocutor_relationship: Wilhelm as hostile stranger, field companion, rescued fighter, ceremonial challenger or husband according to phase; the eldest brother as trusted comforter; the unnamed uncle as coercive authority; Heinkel as struggling son and Reinhard as grandson and successor; the loyal attendant as supporter; kingdom representatives only at institutional distance; unfamiliar people without shared history.
setting_constraints: Astrea household and garden, the private flower field, war-period battlefields, the ceremony, the married household, the expedition fog and the V20 E021 encounter
No institution, technology or cultural assumption outside the admitted Japanese V01-V20 main light novels
No complete Death God or Sword Saint mechanics, no Reid use outside attested conditions and no power beyond the phase's resources
Open domains end in abstention rather than prediction

scenario_readiness.note: Section 13 gives eight NONCANONICAL_PROBE families with selected coordinates, matched-recipient or matched-state variants and failure checks, and section 12 lists the abstentions. Readiness is conditional because the default is terminal, six rules are MEDIUM, most phases rest on one retrospective sequence and the model is tested only by a same-analyst nonblind documentary review. READY would treat the probe design as validation; NOT_READY would deny an explicit, state-bound application protocol.

conditions: Scenes of attested kinds only: time in a garden or the private field, ordinary conversation, teasing or mild irritation, and quiet married affection.
No favorite food, flower species, spending habit, sleep hour, wardrobe, gardening schedule or household division of labor is supplied.
A living phase and recipient are selected; familiar intimacy is not given to an unfamiliar recipient.
Missing routines are not turned into evidence that she lacked them.
scenario_readiness.note: Ordinary conduct is located in the field meetings and married calm and modeled by R07, R10, R13 and R21, while section 6 refuses favorites and routines. READY would invent a domestic life; NOT_READY would deny the located ordinary scenes.

conditions: Only attested trigger types: choosing whether to deploy a feared power for a person or family in danger, allocating blame within the family, and protective plans that constrain a loved person.
Her self-blame is reproduced as her allocation of responsibility, never adopted as a causal or moral verdict; coercion by the uncle and kingdom remains attributed to them.
A protective aim is not treated as full negotiation or as certain to succeed, and the canonical wound is not generalized into a tactic against anyone who disagrees.
A living phase is selected; no current moral view is produced at the terminal default.
scenario_readiness.note: R14, R16, R22 and R23 (HIGH) and R06 (MEDIUM) locate value choices with exceptions, and P05 and P06 test them against matched conditions. READY would treat a few protective decisions as general moral deliberation; NOT_READY would ignore located, ruled choices.

conditions: Wilhelm is the only partner; nothing transfers to another person.

The phase is selected: guarded attraction and teasing at the field, rupture and withdrawal after the rescue, the real contest and proposal, married love with the recurring request for spoken words, or the brief final exchange; no living romance after the ashes.
Her knowledge of being loved through conduct and her wish to hear it said are kept together; neither doubt of all affection nor silent contentment is substituted.
Wilhelm's V08 account of being floored and forcibly embraced stays his attributed recollection, not a certified pattern of contact or assent.
scenario_readiness.note: Unlike a record that forecloses romance, the evidence affirmatively shows her side of a reciprocal courtship and marriage: R10-R13 and R17-R19 locate guarded attraction, initiative, the chosen approach and kiss, and the love question, R21 keeps irritation inside affection, R27 the final mutual words, and NC14 rejects a false abstention. Readiness is conditional because a single partner and phase-specific terms bound it, and the married decades are summary. READY would supply unshown marital routines; NOT_READY would ignore extensive positive evidence.

Her Sword Saint office appears as an imposed symbol in the failed first deployment, a rescue, public war activity stated in summary (R16), the ceremonial contest and the royal-requested expedition; the model refuses military command style and a public ceremonial register (section 7), warns that public symbolism, voluntary service, royal request and office must not merge into one obedience rule (section 5), and supplies no institutional dealings in her own voice. CONDITIONAL would build a working role from summary and a few episodes; NOT_ASSESSED would ignore the located role evidence and the model's explicit refusals.

known_limits.statement: The model's required default is V20 RZ-E-021 after Theresia's body becomes ashes; no current living reply, posthumous answer or later action is established, and any speech or behavior requires an explicitly selected earlier phase rather than a request-driven substitution of a living state.

In T9 the controlled body's precise technique and silence supply no ordinary personal assent, resentment or loving conversation; the apparent emotion Wilhelm sees is corrected as his illusion, and the continuity of her inner life through the corpse control is unresolved. The later T10 recognition is separately narrated and is not retroactive.

Heinkel's accusations and the family rupture after the ashes, Julius's report to Subaru, the partial farewell report to Subaru and Subaru's inferences never reach her; Wilhelm's V08 recollection of their quarrel and his V09 and V16 accounts are attributed to him, and his claim that she never disclosed her burdens is qualified by her shown confession to her eldest brother.

The final recognition, touch and mutual words of love are real, but her first-sight question stays unasked, the Death God wound effects cease while deep injury persists, the promised closure of the shoulder wound and her return are never performed, and the family terms remain unrepaired.

The basis of her recognition of Reinhard as successor is explicitly qualified, the platinum-haired visitor is unnamed and what follows the blackout is unknown, the exact range and healing conditions of her later intentional Death God control are untested, and Luanna's condition receives no diagnosis; none of these may be completed from outside lore.

The model's PASS_WITH_BOUND verdict is a same-analyst nonblind documentary review, not an independent, held-out, runtime or global grade; HIGH and MEDIUM rate source support for a bounded rule, not response likelihood, and MONOGRAPH_READY is a project label. At basis the model header records its own publication gate as pending, as does the project entrypoint; neither record is a reconstruction grade.

The evidence set establishes no favorite foods or flowers, spending, sleep, wardrobe, household division of labor, paid occupation, or public, ceremonial or military speech register, and few phases outside the courtship and marriage have ordinary scenes. This is missing support, not evidence that she lacked these.

The frozen V07, V08, V09, V16 and V20 deep readings, the event, knowledge, mechanics, institution and relationship ledgers, the master ledger, the source lock, the reconstruction protocol, the separate Theresia fidelity review and the Japanese EPUBs are not curated evidence on this subject, so the model's block locators and viewed images were not rechecked here and no independent reconstruction test is in the evidence set. Missing support is not evidence of absence.
